FINDINGS_RANKED.what: The proposed canonical sentence says the repair experiments use GERMLINE Wwox-null juveniles. The source's Materials and Methods says the KO was made by crossing Wwox flox/wt males with BK5-Cre TG/TG, Wwox flox/wt females, with BK5-Cre TG/0; Wwox+/+ controls — a BK5-Cre-driven conditional deletion, not a germline null; 'non-engineered' in the same sentence is wrong for the same reason. The reading's own artefacts disagree: the dossier says 'Germline Wwox KO (BK5-Cre, whole-body)' and 'die by 3-4 weeks', while manifest entries[10] asserts GERMLINE in its proposition and 'whole-body Wwox KO (BK5-Cre)' in its own genotype field. BK5-Cre is also the driver of PMID 22574198 in this same batch, where homozygotes die at day 68-117 and Cre alone explains ~45% of a phenotype.

The three candidates repair the first Aldaz quotation and the hypomorph sentence and leave the second quotation — 'the lifespan of the Wwox heterozygotes was indistinguishable from WT mice' — standing unmarked in both Summary and Source, although PAPER 053's Note already records it as uncited in the review and CC-20260914-22574198-01 measures that ref 55's heterozygotes are BK5-Cre tissue-restricted with survival plotted only to about day 118, so no heterozygote lifespan measurement exists there at all.

FINDINGS_RANKED.item: the dispatch's framing of CLAIM 029, and PAPER 030
FINDINGS_RANKED.what: The dispatch's two measurements are true and their implication is false: the two partial receipts compose to leave no section unread, the second being a declared resumption covering only the supplement the first could not reach. The live defect is the inverse — PAPER 030 declares 'abstract reviewed … full text not yet extracted' against two receipts and 39 locators, and falls outside CC-20260914-EVIDENCE-DEPTH-01's population of records holding a complete receipt, so nothing owns the repair. Worse for the union: CC-20260909-25331887-01, R4-satisfied, has been deferred since BATCH_20260913_001 and carries four narrowings of this claim, including that 'ITCH-dependent' is not evidenced in that supplement — which CLAIM 029's Summary still asserts.

Repair (a) was applied verbatim after its own premise was measured false, so it now asserts inside CLAIM 032's Summary that a quotation there contains the clause 'or carcinogenic', which that quotation does not contain. Accepting a finding in substance while applying its wording unchanged turns the repair into a new false statement about canon's own text.

Neither names the target field, and neither proposes a Source or Wikilinks extension — the defect CC-20260914-17823927-01 calls 'the PAPER 007 defect' and avoids for CLAIM 032. Measured across four scratchpad roots: in Summary without the stub promotions, support_linkage reports 2 UNLINKED_SUPPORT; with them, 0; in a Counter-directional-style block, 0 even unpromoted, because claim_support_fields scans only summary, source and evidence boundary fields and that block is not even a parseable field. legend_lint fires nothing either way, because CLAIM 029 already wikilinks PAPER 030.

The germline-versus-tissue-restricted correction is offered 'at the orchestrator's discretion' and parked in PAPER 053's Note, while CLAIM 032's title and Type assert haploinsufficiency and its Source cites the mammary sentence in support. Left discretionary, the union answers the coherence question NO: the claim keeps citing a somatic tissue-restricted cohort as evidence for germline haploinsufficiency tolerance.

PAPER 078's own Note still reads 'carcinogen-sensitive heterozygous tumour susceptibility' — the record of the paper whose Table 1 carries the untreated excess. Item 1 (e) adds it to the consistency surface to CHECK and proposes no text; the author's response notes the understatement and stops there.

One says spontaneous Myc/Igh translocations increase in primary splenic B cells, non-malignant tissue; the other says the instability phenotype is confined to the tumours and the marrow is quiet. Reconcilable — different compartment, endpoint and assay sensitivity — but the reconciliation is in neither candidate, and a later reader has only the two consecutive sentences.

Four of the five figures in the proposed sentence are carried by propositions whose quoted snippets contain no number (entries[6], [18], [8]); only entries[7] quotes its own. The counts are quoted verbatim one entry away at entries[27]. This is the same repair the author accepted this morning as item 1 (d), recurring in another actor's candidate within the day. Also 'p < 0.01' for 1/77 vs 8/61 reproduces on the uncorrected chi2 (0.0052) but not on Fisher exact (0.0106), and this candidate recomputed its tumour statistics while passing the junction p-values through as printed.

The provenance ceiling is understated: the artefact both item-1 locators name is itself among the five absent, so the figures rest on manifest locator text plus one record-level reading, not on any byte in this checkout.

locator_contradiction_audit recognises only a contradicts_locator object. The four new manifests carry zero of those and four bare 'contradicts' keys, and the tool still reports 31/31 declared at 109 manifests, up from 98. No R4 is triggered — both entries in each pair were born in the same first-contact reading, so no previously persisted locator is contradicted and the candidates' reasoning is right — but a declaration in an unrecognised key cannot be counted.
